clues.it: Marta era nella 9ª colonna, a nord di Rosa e da sola nelle Cucine.
clues.en: Marta was in the 9th column, north of Rosa and alone in the Kitchens.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 2ª riga e accanto a uno sgabello.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 2nd row and beside a stool.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a un calderone e a nord di Rosa.
clues.en: Giada was in the 3rd column, beside a cauldron and north of Rosa.

clues.it: Dario era nella 5ª colonna e nella 5ª riga, ma non era accanto a delle catene.
clues.en: Dario was in the 5th column and in the 5th row, but was not beside loose chains.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 6ª riga, in una stanza diversa da Paolo e nelle Segrete.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 6th row, in a different room from Paolo and in the Dungeon.

clues.it: Tea era nella 8ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e a ovest di Marta.
clues.en: Tea was in the 8th column, in the 7th row and west of Marta.

clues.it: Vito era nella 7ª colonna e nella stessa stanza di Tea.
clues.en: Vito was in the 7th column and in the same room as Tea.

clues.it: Anna era accanto a una libreria, ma non era accanto a uno sgabello.
clues.en: Anna was beside a bookcase, but was not beside a stool.

steps.it: L'indizio di Marta lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Marta's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 9th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Sergio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Sergio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 4ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 4th, column 3rd.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 5ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 5th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 7ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 7th, column 8th.

steps.it: Sergio può stare solo nella 1ª colonna: escludendola, a Rosa resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Sergio can only be in the 1st column: ruling it out leaves Rosa a single square: row 6th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Vito resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Vito a single square: row 8th, column 7th.

steps.it: Tea può stare solo nella 7ª riga: escludendola, a Anna resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Tea can only be in the 7th row: ruling it out leaves Anna a single square: row 9th, column 4th.

steps.it: Anna può stare solo nella 4ª colonna: escludendola, a Paolo resta una sola casella: riga 3ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Anna can only be in the 4th column: ruling it out leaves Paolo a single square: row 3rd, column 6th.
